requirement: Any alternative formulation must explain why the current subject-relative ordinal regression target failed.
required_evidence: Must cite metric-debug and first-pass evidence.
pass_condition: The alternative addresses target compression, rank/absolute-error mismatch, or subject semantics explicitly.

requirement: Any alternative must be design/spec first; no training in the same step.
required_evidence: A separate objective and reviewed spec.
pass_condition: The spec defines labels, target construction, metrics, leakage guards, and stop criteria.

requirement: Any alternative must include a no-training smoke/sanity phase before first-pass training.
required_evidence: Target audit, fold audit, metric sanity, baseline controls.
pass_condition: Smoke tests pass without relying on model performance.

requirement: Any alternative must specify what result would stop/archive it before broad search.
pass_condition: No broad search is allowed without minimal, stable evidence.

requirement: Any alternative must avoid reintroducing the same global binary LOSO or current ordinal target problem without new evidence.
pass_condition: The formulation is materially different or explicitly justified.
